title: Jesus, Why Did David Fight Goliath?

bible.text: But the LORD said to Samuel, "Do not consider his appearance or his height, for I have rejected him. The LORD does not look at the things people look at. People look at the outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart."

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... why did David fight Goliath? He was just a young shepherd!

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: What did everyone else see when they looked at Goliath?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: A giant. Someone nobody could beat.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Someone who dared to challenge the living God.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But wasn't Saul the tallest man in Israel?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Yes. Saul stood head and shoulders above everyone else.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why wasn't he the one who beat Goliath?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Because God's choice was never about height, or strength, or how someone looks.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Wait... so killing Goliath isn't what made David king?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: No. God had already chosen him, long before that battlefield.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then maybe Goliath wasn't David's biggest battle after all...

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What do you see when you look at your own "giants"?
